title: 听力挑战 · 论文答辩

rounds.speaker: 评审专家
rounds.line: Could you clarify what you mean by the term adaptive testing as it appears in your dissertation?
rounds.lineCn: 你能解释一下论文中 adaptive testing 这个术语的含义吗?

grammar.name: 澄清类答辩句式
grammar.note: Could you clarify what you mean by... 是答辩中要求澄清概念的礼貌句式;as it appears in 引导时间/方式从句。

options.text: The examiner asks the candidate to define adaptive testing.
options.feedback: 专家要求澄清论文中该术语的含义。

options.text: The examiner asks about the cover page of the thesis.
options.feedback: 问题针对术语定义,与封面无关。

options.text: The examiner asks about the bibliography format.
options.feedback: 专家问的是术语含义,不是参考文献格式。

rounds.speaker: 答辩学生
rounds.line: I would like to emphasize that our approach differs from traditional methods in several important respects.
rounds.lineCn: 我想强调,我们的方法与传统方法在几个重要方面有所不同。

grammar.name: 强调性学术句式
grammar.note: I would like to emphasize that... 是答辩中突出要点的学术句式;differ from... in... respects 是同义替换中的差异化表达。

options.text: The new approach differs from traditional methods in key respects.
options.feedback: 新方法与传统方法在多个重要方面不同。

options.text: The new approach is identical to traditional methods.
options.feedback: 学生强调的正是二者存在差异。

options.text: The new approach ignores traditional research completely.
options.feedback: 学生说差异,并非完全无视传统方法。

rounds.speaker: 答辩学生
rounds.line: The data we gathered strongly support the hypothesis that earlier exposure leads to better outcomes.
rounds.lineCn: 我们收集的数据有力地支持这样一个假设:更早接触会带来更好的结果。

grammar.name: 数据支持的同义表达
grammar.note: strongly support 的同义替换词有 back up、reinforce、confirm;the hypothesis that... 是同位语从句。

options.text: The gathered data strongly back the earlier-exposure hypothesis.
options.feedback: 数据有力支持更早接触效果更好的假设。

options.text: The data contradict the earlier-exposure hypothesis.
options.feedback: 数据是支持而非反驳该假设。

options.text: The data have no connection with the hypothesis.
options.feedback: 数据与假设直接相关并予以支持。

rounds.speaker: 评审专家
rounds.line: While our findings are promising, we must admit that certain variables remained beyond our control.
rounds.lineCn: 虽然我们的发现令人鼓舞,但必须承认某些变量仍超出了我们的控制。

grammar.name: 让步 + 承认局限句式
grammar.note: While 引导让步从句;beyond our control 与 out of our hands 是同义替换,承认研究局限显示严谨。

options.text: The researchers admit that some variables were uncontrollable.
options.feedback: 研究者承认部分变量无法控制。

options.text: All variables were perfectly controlled in the study.
options.feedback: 原文明确承认有些变量无法控制。

options.text: The findings are meaningless because of the variables.
options.feedback: 发现仍是令人鼓舞的,并未否定其价值。

rounds.speaker: 答辩学生
rounds.line: Finally, I should mention that the framework we propose can be adapted to other fields with minor modifications.
rounds.lineCn: 最后,我应该提到,我们提出的框架经过少量调整即可应用于其他领域。

grammar.name: 适用性拓展句式
grammar.note: be adapted to 与 be applied to 同义;with minor modifications 表示只需小幅调整,是推广价值的表达。

options.text: The framework can be applied to other fields with small changes.
options.feedback: 框架略作调整即可推广到其他领域。

options.text: The framework works only in one narrow field.
options.feedback: 学生强调框架具有推广性,而非局限于单一领域。

options.text: The framework cannot be modified in any way.
options.feedback: 框架正是可以小幅修改的。
